copyright_holder: National Electronics and Computer Technology Center (NECTEC)

clauses.section_1_purpose: Section 1(e) explicitly permits commercial and educational application (การนำไปใช้ประโยชน์ในเชิงพาณิชย์ หรือการถ่ายทอดเทคโนโลยี).
clauses.section_3_a_redistribution_source: Retention of copyright notice and condition list required in source code redistribution.
clauses.section_3_b_redistribution_binary: Reproduction of copyright notice, conditions, and disclaimer required in documentation and materials.
clauses.section_3_c_mandatory_attribution: Derived products must state: "This product is created by the adaptation of LEXiTRON developed by NECTEC (http://www.nectec.or.th/)."
clauses.section_3_d_naming_restriction: Derived products must NOT use the name "LEXiTRON" or NECTEC endorsement without prior written permission.
